module_summary: Sequential 16-bit unsigned shift-and-add multiplier: latches operands, then over 16 counted cycles conditionally accumulates shifted multiplier into a 32-bit product register, pulsing done.

anchors.name: i
anchors.why: Shift/step counter sequencing operand load, 16 accumulate steps and done generation.

anchors.name: yout_r
anchors.why: 32-bit product accumulator adding breg shifted by i-1 when areg bit set; drives yout.

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Starts/holds the multiplication; enables counter and accumulation, clears counter when low.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse from done_r when counter reaches 16, product valid.

anchors.name: areg
anchors.why: Latched multiplicand; bit areg[i-1] gates each accumulate step.

anchors.name: breg
anchors.why: Latched multiplier shifted and added into the product accumulator.

anchors.name: ain
anchors.why: Multiplicand input loaded into areg at step zero.

anchors.name: bin
anchors.why: Multiplier input loaded into breg at step zero.

groups.name: step_control
groups.description: Step counter driven by start, generating the done pulse via done_r.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers and shift-accumulate product register output as yout.
